pages.text: This module adds vanity features and cosmetics for your character.

pages.title: Boat Sails
pages.text: Right-click a boat with a banner to equip a sail.

pages.title: Dyed Item Names
pages.text: Combining an item with dye in an anvil colors its name tooltip. This costs 3 experience levels.

pages.title: Firework Duplication
pages.text: Blank fireworks can be crafted with crafted fireworks to clone them, similar to banners. The original is not consumed; both must have equal flight duration.

pages.title: Stair Chairs
pages.text: Right-clicking a stair block lets you sit on it.

pages.title: Witch Hat
pages.text: Provides minor armor and reduces incoming witch damage.
